FINDING 3 - test_two_concurrent_setups_serialise is a timing race.
MyTradingSys/tests/test_gemini_queue_lock.py. Two threads call gq.add_worktree; setup_lock default timeout 0.3s; per-call fake sleep 0.15s; on a slow runner one thread hits TimeoutError and the assert out==[0,0] gets [0]. Fired in 440d22969 (17:53Z, Step 4.3, [0] != [0, 0]), absent in 238184553 two minutes later, i.e. a flake. Fix is in the test, not gemini_queue: raise the test's timeout to ~2s or use a fake clock. DSA can ship this test change (live_path false), but wait for the verdict on finding 1 first so two reds are not both being fixed blind.

FINDING 4 - The gate is testing a HEAD that is not trunk.
dsa.py boot at 18:25Z reports 'CI green: 5c0b874d6 ... 9 trunk landing(s) / 25 commit(s) behind origin/fast-track'. origin/fast-track HEAD at the same moment is bf475f9ab (23:47 IST = 18:17Z). That is why a fix 'worked' and the same run is still red 20 minutes later.
